en-US.name: FamilyFlow
en-US.summary: Family adventures with parent approval — less scrolling, more living together.
en-US.description: Kids request age-banded family adventures by voice. Parents approve every sensitive step in the FamilyFlow dashboard. Parents only see FamilyFlow activity — not unrelated Alexa conversations or Amazon purchases.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask family flow to suggest an adventure
Alexa, ask family flow to request an adventure

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: 1) Link account with Cognito parent parent@familyflow.demo. 2) Say: Alexa, open family flow. 3) Suggest then request an adventure. 4) Confirm pending approval in parent dashboard.
